comment: Required R packages for the ezprot pipeline. R version pinned to 4.4.0, Bioconductor 3.20. The runtime installs only MISSING packages into the plugin-managed library; never reinstalls what is present. Installer mirrors are configurable (default: Westlake University mirrors).

backgroundBuildOnly.comment: Only needed when building annotation backgrounds for a NEW organism; enrichment/GSEA at runtime use local files and never touch the network.
